# Brajwasi Events

> The premier luxury wedding decoration, sacred temple phool bangla, and bespoke corporate event management company headquartered in Vrindavan, Uttar Pradesh, serving the Braj region, Delhi NCR, and destination venues across India.

## Business Overview
- **Legal & Brand Name**: Brajwasi Events
- **Headquarters**: Gopeshwar Mahadev, Vrindavan, Mathura, Uttar Pradesh, India - 281121
- **Official Website**: https://brajwasievents.com
- **Direct Phone**: +91 84457 18206
- **WhatsApp Inquiries**: +91 84457 18206
- **Primary Operational Footprint**: Vrindavan, Mathura, Agra, Delhi, Noida, Greater Noida, Gurugram (Delhi NCR), and pan-India destination venues.

## Core Specializations

### 1. Luxury Wedding Decoration & Mandap Architecture
- Architectural mandap design combining natural florals, hand-carved pillars, cascading jasmine, and contemporary brass geometry.
- Bespoke stage backdrops, ambient mood lighting, VIP seating layouts, and grand entryway experiential tunnels.
- Full venue transformations for palace weddings, heritage resorts, and luxury banquet grounds.

### 2. Authentic Vrindavan Phool Bangla & Sacred Mandir Florals
- Dedicated expertise in authentic Braj-style Phool Bangla (intricate floral temple mansions) for deities, temple sanctums, and private spiritual gatherings.
- Handwoven floral jaalis, fragrant tuberose (rajnigandha) screens, marigold geometry, and lotus backdrops for Janmashtami, Radhashtami, Holi, and special darshan occasions.

### 3. Corporate Event Management & Brand Summits
- Executive conference styling, stage geometry, high-lumen LED visual backdrops, acoustic tuning, and keynote podium staging.
- Brand launches, dealer meets, gala dinners, and annual awards across Delhi, Noida, Gurgaon, and Agra.

### 4. Engagement, Sangeet & Reception Styling
- Editorial aesthetic with statement photo backdrops, crystal and floral chandeliers, candlelit tablescapes, and choreographed lighting.

### 5. Pan-India Destination Event Production
- Turnkey destination event logistics, on-ground fabrication, vendor supervision, and timeline management for destination weddings and retreats across India.
